Appendix 草稿已写入 `artifacts/appendix_maven_residualized.md`。

结构：Motivation → Method (partial correlation with OLS residualization) → 三张表 (raw correlations, centrality diagnostics, partial correlations) → Discussion (MiniLM frequency confound vs Qwen3 degree confound, Few-NERD 对比) → Conclusion (centrality artifact, pairwise SCS-confusion is the valid claim)。

所有数值均来自 `results.json` 和 `analysis_report.txt`，无虚构数据。MiniLM degree centrality 数据 ($r = +0.909$ at threshold 0.3) 取自 report 中的 centrality diagnostics section。
